description: The grouped bar chart illustrates the GLUE Performance across various Fine-tuning Methods. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled "Fine-tuning Method," and includes Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, $\mathcal{S}_1$-model, $\mathcal{S}_4$-model, and $\mathcal{S}_5$-model. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "GLUE Performance," using a linear scale with numeric tick labels at 86 and 88, indicating an interval of 2, and an overall visible range from approximately 84 to 90. The chart utilizes grouped bars, with each fine-tuning method category containing two side-by-side bars. According to the legend titled "RoBERTa Size," the blue bar on the left of each group represents the "base" size, and the orange bar on the right represents the "large" size. The approximate values for the blue "base" bars are 84.6 for Prefix, 84.4 for Adaptor, 86.6 for LoRA, 84.3 for BitFit (which is the shortest bar in the chart), 85.6 for $\mathcal{S}_1$-model, 86.2 for $\mathcal{S}_4$-model, and 87.0 for $\mathcal{S}_5$-model. The orange "large" bars have approximate values of 85.7 for Prefix, 88.1 for Adaptor, 89.0 for LoRA, 87.7 for BitFit, 85.6 for $\mathcal{S}_1$-model, 87.6 for $\mathcal{S}_4$-model, and 89.3 for $\mathcal{S}_5$-model, which is the tallest bar overall. The categories are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending order by value, and all bars feature a uniform textured fill without any specific individual visual emphasis or annotations.
